title: Handle service disruptions
summary: Review a cancellation policy, its display, and its checks. Keep notes and generated output out of the main path.

sections.title: Name the service states
sections.explanation: A cancelled train is distinct from a delayed one, even when both have a delay value.

sections.title: Put cancellations first
sections.explanation: Cancellation wins over delay. Keep this target in view for the live-edit exercise.

sections.title: Show the disruption on the board
sections.explanation: Three rows show the normal, delayed, and cancelled states side by side.

sections.title: Check cancellation precedence
sections.explanation: A cancelled train with a delay must still display CANCELLED.

sections.title: Explain the symbols
sections.explanation: Short passenger notes describe the same three states.

sections.title: Refresh the display snapshot
sections.explanation: The generated preview mirrors the board output. It is separate from the policy review.
